newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain approves Telefonica golden share.
newsitem.headline: Spain approves Telefonica golden share.

text.p: Spain said on Friday it had approved a golden share in the privatisation of the state's final 21 percent stake in telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana.

"The government has approved the administrative authorisation for Telefonica and Telefonica Moviles. It is an authorisation that tries to safeguard in a selective fashion the national interests of a strategic company," said government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez after the weekly council meeting.

"In this way, any liquidation, spin-off, merger or substitution at Telefonica or Telefonica Moviles, as well as the sale of any particularly key assets of these groups will be subjected to administrative authorisation," Rodriguez said.
The third-party purchase of share stakes larger than 10 percent of capital must also be approved.
